PR3099 Table 1.1 (NZOP 2005).notes: PR3099 (GNS for NZOP, 2005), Table 1.1: operator tops from seismic correlation, m below KB. Report findings: top F-sands = top F1 in Tui-1 and Maui-3 but top F0 (one reflector higher) in Maui-1 and Maui-2; F-sands onlap a structural high and are thin over Maui-2/Maui-3; facies get more distal from Maui toward Tui-1. Recommendation: move the base of the E-shale up ~20 m in Maui-3 so the maximum flooding surface is consistent.
